text:
mia: FYI I opened a small PR to consolidate migration notes + fix lingering v1 snippets across the Guides and Quickstarts. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288 :mag:
owen: thanks. spotted a few oddities: the Ruby quickstart still uses `Redwood::Client.invoke` and the CLI docs use `--model-id`. both should move to v2 patterns.
rahul: can we do canonical v2 examples and a tiny compatibility section? customers hit copy-paste frequently, so add a 1-line banner and a collapsible mapping.
tay: agreed. also add explicit guidance for embeddings alias change (embed-legacy-512 -> rwd-embed-512-v2) and link to /assets/alias_map_v2.json. support keeps getting surprised.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] example-lint failed on docs/quickstarts/ruby.md: found deprecated method Redwood::Client.invoke.
mia: noted. plan: (1) replace deprecated SDK calls with v2 canonical calls across languages; (2) add collapsible "v1 -> v2 quick map" at top of each quickstart; (3) add Go/Ruby minimal snippets where missing; (4) update curl examples to use Authorization header and /v2/responses endpoint.
owen: can you include a minimal streaming hint for curl vs SDK? customers ask how to move from websocket incremental framing to the new SDK stream iterator. a two-line example is enough.
rahul: i'll add small polyfills for JS and Python so teams can opt for a transitional shim: e.g. `invoke_v1_compat(client, model_id, input)` that calls the v2 client under the hood. keep it clearly marked as temporary.
tay: will push the embed alias note and a changelog bullet. product requested the deprecation one-liner: "Docs examples consolidated to v2 canonical patterns; v1 shim available until 2025-12-31." add to changelog and comms blurb.
mia: example replacement samples in PR description (curl):
```bash
# v1 (old)
curl -H "X-Old-Auth: $KEY" -d '{"model":"gpt-3.5","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/invoke
# v2 (canonical)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses
```
plus a short stream note: prefer SDK streaming helpers for correct chunk framing.
docs-ci-bot: [ci] examples job queued for PR 1288. ETA ~8m.
owen: quick nit: for Go snippet prefer idiomatic ctx usage and error handling. i'll tweak after push if needed.
rahul: pushed JS + Python polyfills and a Ruby snippet. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288/files
mia: thanks. action items: (A) Mia: sweep curl + top-of-page collapsibles + PR owner; (B) Rahul: add polyfills and update tests; (C) Tay: changelog line and embed alias note; (D) Owen: tidy Go example and review. Merge gate: two approvals + examples CI green.
comms: product wants a tiny customer-facing line we can paste into an email: "Docs examples now show v2 canonical patterns; the v1 shim remains supported until 2025-12-31."
mia: will add that to PR description and changelog. merging after green. :rocket:
